results.content:
### Love the new format!

When I first downloaded the app, I was a little frustrated because it was performing at a higher level than my Italian level! NOW you can set the level and practice conversation. It’s great!!!

# Love the new format!

When I first downloaded the app, I was a little frustrated because it was performing at a higher level than my Italian level! NOW you can set the level and practice conversation. It’s great!!!

### Annoying problems

I like talking to it but sometimes when I speak to it in Greek, it won’t finish the sentence and it will mysteriously cut off. Also I believe I’m speaking Greek very clear but it will misunderstand what I say and mix up my word with some other word. Other wise I like using this to practice speaking.

# Annoying problems [...] # Very nice application here!

I adore the precision of the algorithms that analyse and correct your pronunciation (the best is here so far that I’ve met!). Yet, you may allow to a user to look at the result of your very last message in the dialogue with the AI. Because as soon as you send your last message, you have no time to observe the result, since you’re being shown your score and other stuff.

### Learning a lot and having fun

Awesome app! Offers audio responses and message transcription, creating conversational experience that flows surprisingly naturally. Early product, but the team seems to make updates quite frequently. Just upgraded to paid - quickly hit my daily limit! Excited to continue using the product and see how the product grows from here. [...] # Learning to speak, from passive to active.

This is a fabulous app for foreign language learners because it makes possible actual back-and-forth conversation. It satisfies a very important need that older programs and even classroom instruction lack. Now one can talk about anything in a natural unstructured way, with mistakes unobtrusively corrected. It helps the learner overcome inhibitions, start talking, and gain fluency. I also love this app because it is a very positive and beneficial use of AI. It doesn’t dumb us down or make us lazy. Quite the opposite. Kudos to the developers!

### Great app for speaking out loud

results.title: See the latest updates on Langua - LanguaTalk Knowledge Base
results.content:
Dec 11th: It has been a frustrating month as 3 of our key AI technology providers have faced major capacity issues due to their rapid growth outpacing their ability to scale their infrastructure. In response to these issues, we now automatically switch the provider if one doesn't respond within a certain amount of time. This doesn't make the system bulletproof and delays can still occur. We're continually monitoring the situation and making adjustments to minimize the impact of these provider issues, and we're exploring ways to make our systems more resilient. You can also switch 'AI model' and 'transcription model' via Settings.

  

November 2024

Nov 26th: New work & business roleplays + added History tab to menu (with ability to edit conversation titles).
